convert_priority_to_percent_float: convert a plain float priority value to a percentage between 0.0 and 1.0
convert_priority_to_percent_dict_percent: convert a dict with percent type to a normalized priority percentage
convert_priority_to_percent_dict_rpm: convert a rpm-based priority dict to a percentage using model rpm limit
convert_priority_to_percent_dict_tpm: convert a tpm-based priority dict to a percentage using model tpm limit
convert_priority_to_percent_fallback: convert a priority dict to percentage with fallback to percent type when type is unrecognized
